name: Manifest Claws
body:
You have wicked claws with which you can attack.

Prerequisite: Anumus, species with claws.

Benefit: You gain claws as a natural attack. They do 1d4 damage (critical x2). You are considered proficient with this attack.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
